abyssal angel.d:
Fires long range bolts infused with Void Energy dealing Moderate Damage enhanced by your Spell Power. Can hit up to three targets. Each bolt exposes their deepest sins dealing a Minor DoT for 3 seconds. Stacks to 6.
Note: Applies Sinned Arrow to all targets hit, dealing DoT damage over 4 seconds. Vice Bolt's DoT increases by its base damage per stack.

Spreads it's wings and takes flight. Applies Vantage Point, increasing Hit Chance and Dodge by 15% for 6 seconds. Also allows you to focus all your fire on one target, empowering your arrows increasing your overall DoT Damage by 75%. Your focused targeting reduces the amount of void energy you need to expend, applying Mana Refraction which reduces mana costs by 50% for 8 seconds.
Notes:
Applies Vantage Point to caster for 6 seconds, increasing Hit Chance and Dodge by 15%, increasing DoT damage by 50%, and making all attacks single target.
Applies Mana Refraction to caster for 8 seconds, reducing mana costs by 50%.

If Vantage Point is in play, you send shadow imgages striking up to 4 targets for Moderately Strong Damage. Applies Aghast, stunning the opponents for 3 seconds. If Vantage Point is not in play, applies Catalyst, siphoning their Haste, lowering it by 20% while maxing out your Haste for 8 seconds.
Notes:
If Vantage point is not active, applies Catalyst to caster for 8 seconds, increasing haste by 50%.
If Vantage point is not active, applies Catalyst to target enemies, lowering their haste by 20%.
If Vantage point is active, applies Aghast, stunning the target enemy for 3 seconds.

Suppresses your inner Void Energy to temporarily put you in a stasis granting you a High HoT and quadrupling your Endurance for 10 seconds.
Note: Applies Fallen's Judgement to caster for 9 seconds, quadrupling caster's endurance and applying a HoT to caster that ticks every second.

Spawns Crystals from thin air to increase 25% Damage Resistance for 8 seconds. Also applies Clean Cut, increasing your Crit Chance by 15% for 6 seconds.
Note:
Applies Clean Cut to caster, increasing caster's crit chance by 15% for 7 seconds.
Applies Crystallis Veil to caster, increasing caster's damage resistance by 25% for 9 seconds.

Always Hit Their Mark…
Increases Hit Chance by 10% and Critical Strike Damage by 15%
Notes:

alpha pirate.d: A basic attack, taught to all adventurers. Damage dealt is based on your weapon damage.
A cutlass is the primary weapon of a pirate and is their weapon of choice. Applies Cutlass and Combo, increasing your Crit Chance by 3% and Crit Damage by 7% for 8 seconds, stacks to 5.

You use your pirate sense to steal treasure to aid you in battle, who knows exactly what you'll get? Applies 1 of 3 effects to yourself:
Plunder Health: HoT
Plunder Dodge: 30% Dodge
Plunder Crit: 30% Crit Damage
Effects last 8 seconds.

You always carry a pistol around saving it for the opportune moment. Applies either Cannon Burn, damaging your target over time, or Cannon Fodder, reducing your target's Damage Resistance by 20%. Both effects last 8 seconds.
Haste increased by 6% and Dodge increased by 12%.
Let off a blast of cannon fire from your conveniently nearby but hidden ship. Applies Cannon Wound, reducing your target's outgoing damage by 25% for 8 seconds.

antique hunter.d: Artifact Hunters gain mana from all hits landed in combat, and especially on crits. The amount depends on damage relative to *their own* HP total.
A strong attack known only to disciplined fighters. Damage dealt is based on weapon damage.
You strike using power amassed from the Blade of Awe. You have a 25% chance to leave your opponent awestruck which stuns them for 2 seconds.

Using the power of the supreme Arcane staff you deal damage and applies the Supreme Arcane Burn DoT to your Opponent.
Note: Supreme Arcane Burn lasts 6 seconds. Always hits and crits.

Using the power of the shiny mirror you deflect a portion of your opponent's attack back at them and improve your resistance by 80% 6 seconds.
Notes:
Applies Burning Ward to the caster, reflecting damage for 6 seconds. Can deal a maximum of 1,000 damage per tick to the opponent.
Applies Mirrored Resists to the caster, increasing damage resistance by 90% for 6 seconds.
Dodge, Crit and Hit chance all increased by 5%.

You’ve come across many blessed and cursed items over the years and learned how to channel their energies to work in your favor. You either trigger DOOM which increases your Damage output by 40%, Strength by 30% and Crit chance by 15% DESTINY, which gives you a large HoT Heal Over Time, increases your Intellect by 30% and Haste by 15%.
Notes:
Has a 50% chance to apply Doom or Destiny. Both effects last 6 seconds.

arachnomancer.d: Sink your fangs into your opponent, siphoning health from opponents affected by your Venom Fangs.
Bite your target with Venom Fangs, injecting them with a powerful toxin for 4 seconds. Retreat with the grace of an arachnid, increasing your Dodge by 70% for 1 second.

Constrict your opponent with steel-like spider thread coated in poison, causing damage over time for 10 seconds that increases the lower your health is. Retreat with the grace of an arachnid, increasing your Dodge by 70% for 1 second.
Note: Applies Web Miasma, which also reduces enemy dodge by 30%.
A powerful strike of self-abandon that costs 10% of your max HP and tears away at their armor. Inflict your foe with Panic, increasing the DoT they take by 100% for 12 seconds.
Your powerful poisons increase the Damage over Time you deal by 18%.
Arachnid instincts drive you to always strike for your opponent’s weakness, increasing Crit Chance by 10%.

Toxic adrenaline flows through your veins and with your webbing, melting your body and your opponent’s armor. Cocoon your foe with your toxic webbing, costing 20% of your max HP, increasing the damage they take by 100% for 12 seconds.

Your hunts are blessed by Arachne, increasing your Haste by 10%.
Note: This skill is a reference to Arachne.
Notes:
Lorepedia Entry.

arcana invoker.d: The Arcana Invoker regains 15 mana when they strike a target with Arcana Invocation (affected by Mana Consumption).

Deliver a strike with your blade of flesh. Deals physical damage based on your Attack Power and Spell Power.
Note: Deals 60% physical damage.

Begin the cycle anew by summoning The Fool, increasing your Damage Resistance by 80% for 122 seconds.
If Judgement is active, instead summon The World for 122 seconds, increasing your Damage Resistance by 40% and changing the effects of your other skills.
If The World is active, instead deals damage based on your stacks of End of the World.
Using this skill while Judgement isn't active will reset the cycle. Can't miss.
Note: Deals 222% magical damage.

If The Fool is present, summon an Arcana. Arcana are summoned in a set order, with each one granting you a new effect and the effects of all previously summoned Arcana. Each time an Arcana is summoned, your Damage Resistance is reduced by 2% until The World is summoned.
If The World is active, instead applies End of the World for 8 seconds, increasing the damage of this skill, but reducing your Damage Resistance by 4% for each stack. Recovers 15 mana on hit. Can't miss.
Notes:
All Arcana Buffs continue to stay active during The World.
Deals 60% magical damage.

Channel a magical attack through your Arcana, applying a Reversed effect to your target based on your currently summoned Arcana. All effects last 22 seconds unless otherwise specified.
If The Fool is your only active Arcana, applies The Fool (Reversed).
If Judgement is active, deals bonus damage to your targets.
If The World is active, applies The World (Reversed) for 5 seconds, applying all Reversed stat debuffs and stuns at half potency. Can't Miss.
Note: Deals 80% magical damage.

Perform the Arcana's ritual, using your foe as the offering! Applies Sacrifice to your target, increasing the damage they take from each successive hit of this skill by 150%, up to 22 times.

arcane dark caster.d: Arcane Dark Casters gain mana from all hits landed in combat, and especially on crits. The amount depends on damage relative to *their own* HP total.
Fire out a blast of dark energy, with a 20% chance to make your target Flinch, stunning them for 1 second. Damage dealt is based on Spell Power and Arcane Overwhelming.
You gather the darkness within and unleash it in a quick flurry of black arcane energy. Inflicts your target with Consumed by Shadows, a 15 second DoT that stacks to 20.

You leach at the darkness within your foe, absorbing health from them while damaging them over time and reducing their Hit Chance, Crit Chance, and Dodge by 15% for 15 seconds. Can't miss.
Notes:
Dark Leech refreshes but does not stack.
Does 100% Magical Damage.

Concentrate your shadow magic and summon an Arcane Shadow Minion to buff your dark magic and defend you (only appears if summoned outside of combat). The two of you form a Pact, increasing Outgoing Damage and Damage Resistance by 10% for 15 seconds, stacks to 5.
Notes:
Pact refreshes and stacks to 5.
Pet is Arcane Shadow Minion.
Outgoing Magic Damage and Hit Chance increased by 20%.

You focus intently, completely enveloping yourself in arcane energy and fully restoring your mana. For 5 seconds, Dark Pulse deals damage based on your target's Consumed by Shadows stacks, your Haste and Dodge are increased by 30%, and Crit Chance by 100%. You become Silenced for the duration, being unable to use skills that cost mana.

Haste increased by 15%. Draw upon your Arcane Shadow Minion's mana reserves while they're inactive, reducing mana costs by 100%. Each time you form a Pact with your minion, your mana costs increase by 20% for 15 seconds, up to 5 times.

archfiend.d: Archfiends gain mana from all hits landed in combat, and especially on crits. The amount depends on damage relative to *their own* HP total. The lower your HP, the less mana you'll heal.
Strike your opponents and curse them with a Mark of Death, increasing the damage they take by 4% for 12 seconds, stacks to 8.
Lash out at your opponent, dealing damage while drawing strength from the Abyss. Applies a stack of ArchFiend's Mark to yourself, increasing Crit Chance by 5% for 12 seconds, stacks to 8.

Unleash the twisted power of the Abyss onto your opponents. You enter your natural Fiendish state, granting you 25% Haste for 6 seconds while your foes are Consumed by the Abyss, lowering their Dodge by 25% for 6 seconds.

Your abyssal power sends you and your allies into a Fiendish Frenzy, increasing Crit Damage by 120% for 8 seconds. If you have stacks of Archfiend's Mark, also apply Fiend Leech to yourself, a 2 second HoT that increases in power based on the number of Archfiend's Mark stacks.
Your newfound abyssal lineage increases your effectiveness on the battlefield, increasing Crit Damage by 30%, but reducing your magic damage by 75%.
Your abyssal visage grants you superior reflexes, increasing your hit chance and crit chance by 12%.

Bind your opponents to the Abyss. Consumes all stacks of Archfiend's Mark and deals damage based on the amount consumed. Also applies Abyssal Contract for 10 seconds, increasing the physical damage your opponents take by 30%, plus 5% for each stack of Mark of Death they have (up to 70% total).

Sensing your foes near defeat, below 10% of their health, you have a 25% chance each time you mark your opponent to inflict a heavy DoT.
Notes:
Previously called "Legendary ArchFiend" and before "Legendary ArchFiend Class".

archivist of temporis.d: Archivists fully restore their mana upon using the Lorebook of Beginnings.

Inscribe Lore, beginning a spell. Rewrite your opponent's timeline, dealing more damage with each stack of Page Turned.
Notes:
Restores 100 mana.
Deals 66% hybrid damage as magical damage.

Peer into the library of time, invoking The First Index if you've Inscribed Lore, which is used to apply damaging spells. Applies a different effect based on your currently active Index.
The First Index: This skill deals increased damage
The Second Index: Acutance - +50% Crit Chance for 12s
The Third Index: Fortification - +75% END & -25% mana costs for 24s
Note: Deals 50% magical damage.

Peer into the library of time, invoking The Second Index if you've Inscribed Lore, which is used to apply enchanting spells. Applies a different effect based on your currently active Index.
The First Index: Splotched - DoT based on your target's current HP percentage for 6s
The Second Index: Vehemency - +40% Physical & Magical Damage for 12s
The Third Index: Resiliency - +50% Damage Resistance for 24s
Note: Deals 50% magical damage.

Peer into the library of time, invoking the Third Index if you've Inscribed Lore, which is used to apply protection spells. Applies a different effect based on your currently active Index.
The First Index: Page Turned - Every successive Lorebook of Beginnings does more damage for 24s
The Second Index: Superpower - +30% INT/STR & 15% Luck for 12s
The Third Index: Rewind - HoT for 24s
Note: Deals 50% magical damage.
Haste and Outgoing Damage increased by 30%.
Starting at rank 1, your inscriptions bind to the pages, causing all skills to be guaranteed hits.

Rewrite the fabric of time, recasting your previously used spells. Refreshes the duration of all active Index buffs on yourself while granting them to your allies for 12 seconds.
Note: The DoT from Splotched and Increased damage from The First Index and are not refreshed or shared.

Crit Chance increased by 15%. The first time Lorebook of Beginnings is used in combat, it applies Epigraph, increasing your Damage Resistance by 50% for 8 seconds.
Notes:

archmage.d: Archmages read the flow of the Ley Lines around them, regenerating mana only with the use of certain abilities.
Incant an unavoidable status spell and inflict your foes with Leywilt, reducing Dodge by 35%, damage by 25%, and Crit Chance by 15% for 20 seconds.

Set ablaze the mana current, consuming the foes around you in an intense inferno and thawing any afflicted with Cryostasis. The fire ravenously burns, dealing more damage the lower your MP and leaving them burning based on the damage dealt, stacking to 2 and lasting 6 seconds.
Note: Applies the Arcane Flux aura.

Still the flow of the mana stream, flash freezing your foes in place and drawing in 15 mana for yourself. Your foes remain in Cryostasis, reducing their Hit Chance and Damage dealt by 30% while they take 30% increased magic damage for 6 seconds.
Note: Applies the Arcane Flux aura.

Agitated mana bursts forth from you, engulfing your foes in a radiant supernova dealing more damage the lower your life force is.
Note: Applies the Arcane Flux aura.
Your mastery over the magical arts increases your Hit Chance and Crit Chance by 25%.
Your ability to attune with the mana flow and influence it grants you 15% Haste.

Inscribe an Arcane Sigil, significantly increasing your magical power. Your Arcane Sigil increases your Damage Dealt by 30% for 30 seconds, but the Overload of the spell increases your mana costs by 50% for 4 seconds and costs 40% of your current health.
Notes:
When Arcane Flux is in effect, consumes Astral Ascension and applies Corporeal Ascension, giving the caster 250% END, 60% Crit Chance, and a large rapid HoT based on mana when cast.
When Corporeal Ascension is in effect, consumes Corporeal Ascension and applies Astral Ascension, granting rapid mana regen, 60% more DoT damage, 20% Dodge, 5% Haste, and a small rapid HoT based on mana when cast.

From rank 5, your Sigils can use Arcane Flux to empower you, shifting you between two forms. At rank 10, 10% INT.
Casting Sigil with Arcane Flux shifts you into Corporeal Ascension, giving you 250% END, 60% Crit Chance and a large rapid HoT based on your mana when you cast.
Casting Sigil in Corporeal Ascension shifts you into Astral Ascension, granting you rapid mana regen, 60% DoT damage, 20% Dodge, 5% Haste, and a small rapid HoT based on your mana when you cast.
Notes:

Applies Divine, reducing enemy Dodge by 10% per stack, stacks up to 6 and lasts 10 seconds.

Applies Eminent, reducing enemy Hit Chance, outgoing damage, and Crit Chance all by 5%, stacks up to 6 and lasts 10 seconds.

A forgiving light encompasses you and up to 6 allies, recovering a great amount of health that always crits and granting you 20% defense and END for 15 seconds.
Notes:
Heals for 380% Hybrid Damage.
Applies Hymn of Light, increasing END and Defense by 20% for 15 seconds.

Using holy magic, you temporarily seal the offensive powers of your opponent away. Your foe does 90% less damage for 7 seconds. Undead foes are stunned by the holy power of the seal for 3 seconds.
Notes:
Deals 135% Hybrid Damage.
Applies Righteous Seal, reducing opponent's outgoing damage by 90% and lasts for 7 seconds. In addition, Righteous Seal stuns Undead enemies for 3 seconds.

Your credence grants you an extra 100% Endurance and 10% hit chance.

chrono assassin.d: You wield Strike Blades. Manipulating with time allows you to attack incredibly fast, but sacrificing power.

Push time forward with your next strike dealing Light Damage to your opponent. Applies Push Time, increasing your Dodge and Haste by 8% for 12 seconds, stacks to 5. If Reverse Time is in play, Strike Blades will replace it with Temporal Blades increasing your Damage Output by 30% and applying Pull Time, lowering the opponent's Haste and Dodge by 15% for 12 seconds.
Notes:
Applies Push Time to caster for 12 seconds, increasing haste and dodge by 8% per stack, stacking to 5 (Note that haste stacking currently does not function, so haste will only be increased at most 8% from push time.).
If Reverse Time is active, applies Temporal Blades to caster for 12 seconds, increasing all damage dealt by caster by 30%. (Temporal Blades is not refreshed when re-applied).
If Reverse Time is active, applies Pull Time to enemy target for 12 seconds, lowering their Haste and Dodge Chance by 15%.
If Reverse Time is active, applies Overse Time to caster for 1 second, which removes Reverse Time.

Relieve time with your next strike dealing Moderate Damage to your opponent. Applies Deadlock to yourself, stacks 4 times. Once max stacked Deadlock will consume itself and apply Reverse Time, granting you a Moderate HoT for 10 seconds.
Notes:
Applies Deadlock to caster for 12 seconds.
At 5 stacks of Deadlock, applies Reverse Time to caster for 10 seconds.

Generate time with your next strike dealing Moderate Damage to your opponent. Applies Condense Time, increasing Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage by 10% for 12 seconds, stacks to 5. If Reverse Time is in play, Strike Blades will replace it with Temporal Blades increasing all damage out by 30% and apply Depress Time, lowering the opponent's Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage by 15% for 12 seconds.
Notes:
Applies Condense Time to caster for 12 seconds, increasing Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage by 10%, stacking to 5.
If Reverse Time is active, applies Temporal Blades to caster for 12 seconds, increasing all damage dealt by caster by 30%. (Temporal Blades is not refreshed when re-applied).
If Reverse Time is active, applies Depress Time to enemy target for 12 seconds, lowering enemy target's Critical Strike Chance and Critical Strike Damage Damage by 15%.
If Reverse Time is active, applies Overse Time to caster for 1 second, which removes Reverse Time.
Increases Hit Chance and Crit Chance by 10%

Sever your foe's mind in time causing them to go insane. For the next 6 seconds the target will hit itself instead of you. If Reverse Time isn't in play you get Enhance Time, reducing the damage your target takes by 15%. If Reverse Time is in play, its removed and you get Temporal Blades while your opponent gets Corrupt Time. Temporal Blades increases your damage by 30%. Corrupt Time increases your opponent's damage by 15%. They last 12 seconds.
Notes:
Applies Temporal Insanity! to target enemy for 6 seconds, reflecting their damage dealt back onto themself.
Applies Enhance Time! to enemy target for 12 seconds, reducing all damage they take by 15%.
If Reverse Time! is active, applies Corrupt Time! to enemy target for 12 seconds, increasing target enemy's damage output by 15%.
If Reverse Time! is active, applies Temporal Blades to caster for 12 seconds, increasing all damage dealt by caster by 30%. (Temporal Blades is not refreshed when re-applied).
If Reverse Time! is active, applies Overse Time! to caster for 1 second, which removes Reverse Time.
Notes:

Fire out a blast of dark energy, with a 20% chance to make your target Flinch, stunning them for 1 second. Damage dealt is based on Spell Power and Arcane Overwhelming.
You gather the darkness within and unleash it in a quick flurry of black arcane energy. Inflicts your target with Consumed by Shadows, a 15 second DoT that stacks to 20.

You leach at the darkness within your foe, absorbing health from them while damaging them over time and reducing their Hit Chance, Crit Chance, and Dodge by 15% for 15 seconds. Can't miss.

Does 100% Magical Damage.

You become Silenced for the duration, being unable to use skills that cost mana.

Haste increased by 15%. Draw upon your Arcane Shadow Minion's mana reserves while they're inactive, reducing mana costs by 100%. Each time you form a Pact with your minion, your mana costs increase by 20% for 15 seconds, up to 5 times.

mythic elemental warrior.d: Strike your opponents from a further range with your Axe.

Infuse yourself with Elemental Power, reducing your mana cost and Damage Taken by 15% for 5 seconds and priming your elemental abilities. Your blade rends the air, inflicting your foe with a Mana Rift, decreasing their Dodge and Crit Chance by 15% for 10 seconds. Cannot miss but cannot crit.

Strike your opponent with fiery wrath, dealing large damage and converting your Elemental Power to Fire Magic. If you possess Earth Magic, the fusion makes you Incandescent, increasing your Endurance by 100% and Healing Intake by 200% for 20 seconds. If you possess Energy Magic, the fusion grants you Critical Mass, increasing your Crit Chance by 25% and Crit Damage by 125% for 10 seconds.

Call upon the power of the earth, healing yourself. If Elemental Power is present, you heal twice as much and convert it into Earth magic. If you possess Fire Magic, the fusion creates Molten Armor, reducing the damage you take by 60% for 20 seconds. If you possess Energy Magic, the fusion grants you an Earthen Blessing, healing you for a small amount over the next 20 seconds.
The power of darkness grants you 15% increased Strength and 75% increased Endurance.
The power of Light grants you 15% increased Intellect and 12% increased Haste and Hit Chance.

Overloaded mana bursts forth from your weapon, dealing great damage to your foe based on your current mana and converting your Elemental Power to Energy Magic. If you possess Fire Magic, the fusion turns you into a Superconductor, increasing your Damage by 50% for 10 seconds. If you possess Earth Magic, the fusion Grounds you, increasing your Haste by 20% for 10 seconds.

Starting at rank 1, when invoking Elemental Power, you have a very small chance of creating powerful Ice Magic. Fusing this magic with different elements can lead to very brief but powerful effects.
Ice and Fire makes you Supercritical, increasing your STR and INT by 200%, and LUK by 20%.
Ice and Earth creates Hailstone, healing you greatly.
Ice and Energy creates Hoarfrost, reducing your Mana Cost by 200% for 5 seconds- causing you to generate mana instead!
Notes:

Ultra Elemental Warrior.

Fire your pistol at your target, wounding them and reducing their Damage Resistance by 30% for 10 seconds.

The presence of the captain inspires everyone in battle. Grants you and your allies an HoT and increases Haste Outgoing Damage by 15%. Also applies a stack of Armada to you for each ally, increasing the damage of all skills except En Garde by 50%, stacks to 4. Effects last 15 seconds.
You sidestep attacks with your Sea Legs, increasing your Dodge by 30% for 1 second.
Haste increased by 10% and Dodge increased by 30%.
You pull out your second pistol and unleash a hail of bullets. Applies Focus for 4 seconds, which forces your target to attack only you for the duration.

Decreases incoming damage by 15%.

Unleash an ancient disease that damages your target and infects their cells with Necrosis, a DoT that lasts 5 seconds, stacks up to 25.

Use your life essence to tap into the power of time. Deals damage and applies Chaos Rift to yourself for 30 seconds, stacks up to 4 and is used for your other abilities. You also enter an Eternal Frenzy, increasing your outgoing damage by 12% for 8 seconds, stacks up to 8. Also applies Passage of Time, which slowly damages you as long as you're in Frenzy, stacks to 100.

Your mastery of time magic combined with your necromancy arts allow you to conjure undead in an instant. Summons an undead minion that deals increased damage the lower your health is. Applies Traveling Through Time, increasing your haste by 30%. Also applies Foreseeable Future, increasing your Crit Chance by 20%, stacks to 3. Both effects last 8 seconds.

Tear open a portal in time and draw upon immense power from a past battle. Deals increased damage to your target for each stack of Necrosis on them. If Chaos Rift is active, your primary target takes damage over the next second based on the amount of damage you've dealt in the past 10 seconds while Chaos Rift was active. Damage scales with each stack of Chaos Rift and consumes those stacks. Applies Unleashing Doom, preventing Chaos Rift from being applied for 1 second.
Hit Chance and Dodge increased by 10%
HoT and DoT power increased by 10%

Relive the rebirth of your Empress. If you have stacks of Chaos Rift, they are consumed to apply Empress’s Awakening, healing you over 1 second. Also applies Flow of Time, removing any stacks of Passage of Time you have while increasing your HoT and DoT for power by 20% for 12 seconds.

not a mod.d: You're just a normal gamer, what good would mana do you?
You already know how this one works.

Don't think about what this skill does, just use it because it comes off cooldown really fast. Deals stacking bonus damage and increases your Dodge by 10% if the last skill used was this one, up to 15 times. Using another skill removes the Dodge and damage bonus. Can't crit.

This is a completely average hit which does perfectly normal damage…
What do you mean this is just another Auto Attack? You want this skill to actually do something? Ok fine, if you want a way for this class to recover mana that bad, then this skill now FULLY recovers your mana, ARE YOU HAPPY?

Attack first, do the tutorial later. Outgoing damage increased by 10%.
You grow wings and can fly. Lol just kidding, all you get is 10% more Haste.

Furious that your button mashing is getting you nowhere, you throw your keyboard at your target in a fit of rage, dealing increased damage based on how much you Button Mashed and stunning them for 3 seconds. Heals yourself and up to 6 others, while placing a random judgment on each based on their relationship with the Divine. The heal is twice as strong if another player is selected. If an enemy is selected, you will be healed for twice the amount.
Note: List of different effects:
Close Friends: Increases Strength & Intellect by 20% for 20 seconds.
Befriended: Strong heal over time for 15 seconds.
Divine Acquaintances: Moderate heal over time for 15 seconds.
It's Complicated: Reduces damage taken and Luck by 10% for 10 seconds.
Unfriended: Increases mana costs by 10% and reduces Endurance by 10% for 10 seconds.

You tap into your photographic memory to foretell the future. Applies Shared Link to either you or an ally (click an ally to target them). Shared Link increases chance to dodge by 50% and critical strike chance by 30% for 10 seconds.

Advanced precognition allows you to read your opponent's timeline and notify allies of their weaknesses. You deal moderate damage and apply either Blocked, reducing 80% of your opponent's physical damage, or Ignored, reducing 80% of your opponent's magical damage for 8 seconds.

On rare occasions the Oracle and his entire group are granted Divine Recovery fully healing them and granting temporary invulnerability.

Applies one stack of Mad for every use of Timeless Strike.

Deals damage to your target and applies Temporal Rift to you. Temporal Rift stacks 4 times, lasts 30 seconds and is used by your other abilities.

Reverses time to heal you. Heal is increased by stacks of Temporal Rift and consumes those stacks.

Applies Corruption Through Time. Corruption Through Time increases all damage you do by 20% for 10 seconds. Doesn’t stack.

Transient for 10 seconds, a self DoT that increases in strength.

Applies Potential, increasing your Hit Chance by 20% for 20 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
If Timepiece of Inevitability is active, applies the following effects:
Applies Inevitable Corruption, increasing your outgoing damage and haste by 12% for 20 seconds.
Using the Timepiece of Inevitability while Inevitable Corruption is active applies Snap to your opponent, dealing significant damage to them after a short delay. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
If Timepiece of Pestilence is active, applies the following effects:
Applies Infectious Air, increasing the amount of damage the enemy takes by 20% for 10 seconds, stacking to 3 but is consumed by Temporal Collapse.
Your incoming damage is increased by 100% for 10 seconds.
Applies a light DoT to your opponent.
Applies Decay to your opponent, preventing them from healing.

Fuel the Flames of a Magnum Opus Forge, empowering the next skill you use for 20 seconds.

Scorch your target with putrefying flames. Applies Black Flames to your target, a 6 second fast DoT. Black Flames are consumed by your other damaging skills to deal double damage and apply Cremate, reducing DoT Resistance by 10% for 10 seconds, stacks to 10.
Fuel The Flame: Applies Decay to your target for 5 seconds. Also applies Decomposing Flames for 20 seconds, increasing Black Flames' stack limit to 3 and causing skills that consume it to deal 150% more damage for each additional stack.
Note: Deals 40% magical damage.

Consume your opponent in purifying fire! Applies White Flames to your target, a 10 second DoT that reduces Outgoing Damage, Crit Chance, and Dodge by 20%.

Note: Deals 80% magical damage.

Heals yourself with enlightening flames and applies Burning Ward for 6 seconds, increasing your Damage Resistance by 15%, healing you over time, and causing foes who strike you to take damage, up to 1,000 per hit.

Note: Heals you for 75% magical damage.

Your devastating, unavoidable blade is one of rite and fury. Recite the Preamble, increasing your Physical and Magical Resistance by 80% for 3 seconds. Upholding your oath applies In Omnia Paratus, blocking further recitations.
If Castellan Doctrine is present, applies Overwatch, reducing your target’s Crit Chance by 15% and Luck by 30%. If Venator Doctrine is present, applies Beholden, reducing your target’s Hit Chance by 15% and Damage Resistance by 30%. Both effects last 15 seconds.

Applies Preamble to the player for 3 seconds, increasing Physical and Magical Resistances by 80%.
Applies In Omnia Paratus to the enemy, which blocks Preamble for the rest of the fight.
Reducing Luck only affects enemy players.

Deals damage and heals you. The lower your health, the greater the damage and healing are. Applies Offensive Stance, increasing your Crit Damage by 50% for 7 seconds. Replaces Defensive Stance.

Always hits.

Throw a deadly shadow poison tipped kunai at your target. Shadow kunai will continually damage your opponent from a far, stacking 10 times and lasting 8 seconds if not restacked. You gain foresight with each throw, making all auto attacks within the next 5 seconds crit.

Focus all your chi into restoring your life force over time. Chi Heal lasts 4 seconds and cannot stack. As the chi flows through your veins you become rejuvenated and whole. Chi Heal also increases you Endurance by 50% for 14 seconds. Chi Heal cannot stack.
Meditate, transferring yourself in the shadow realm to restore your mana. While meditating you can't attack or use abilities and you will take up to 80% less damage for 5 seconds.
Increases endurance by 18% and Dodge by 15%
Increases haste by 10% and Damage over Time effects are 30% stronger.

This attack applies Spinning Dragon which reduces your target's next hit to 0 damage.

If your target is afflicted with Dragon's Bane, applies Instilled Fear, reducing their Haste and Dodge by 25% for 20 seconds.

Deals damage on hit and grants a stack of Consuming Shadows which which debuffs your damage resistance by 8% and increases the damage done on all of your skills for 20 seconds. Stacks to 10. Also applies Overwhelming Shadows to your target, reducing their haste and damage by 15% for 2 seconds.

Disperse the shadows in a blast of dark energy. Deals damage to up to 6 targets and has a 50% chance to petrify them for 1 second. Applies 1 stack of Consuming Shadows per target hit. You also gain Rush of Unlife which increases your haste by 40% for 8 seconds.

Rips the bones right out of your enemies! Deals damage to up to 6 targets and applies a stack of Consuming Shadows. Also applies a stack of Undead Assembly which increases your damage done and healing done by 10%. Undead Assembly lasts 15 seconds and stacks to 4.

Increases damage resistance to a max of 80% and prevents 10% of damage resistance debuffs.

Entropic Harm for 10 seconds, increasing damage taken by 150%.
Entropic Mana for 7 seconds, increasing haste by 30% and reducing mana costs by 50%.

Focus for 3 seconds, forcing affected monsters to attack you.

Foresee for 150 seconds.

Transient for 10 seconds, a self DoT that increases in strength.
Using Corruption Through Time again replaces Transient with Ephemeral for 5 seconds, increasing dodge and damage by +50%.

Applies Potential, increasing your Hit Chance by 20% for 20 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
If Timepiece of Inevitability is active, applies the following effects:
Applies Inevitable Corruption, increasing your outgoing damage and haste by 12% for 20 seconds.
Using the Timepiece of Inevitability while Inevitable Corruption is active applies Snap to your opponent, dealing significant damage to them after a short delay. Cooldown: 20 seconds.

Applies Infectious Air, increasing the amount of damage the enemy takes by 20% for 10 seconds, stacking to 3 but is consumed by Temporal Collapse.
Your incoming damage is increased by 100% for 10 seconds.
Applies a light DoT to your opponent.
Applies Decay to your opponent, preventing them from healing.

If you possess Earth Magic, the fusion Grounds you, increasing your Haste by 20% for 10 seconds.

Ice and Fire makes you Supercritical, increasing your STR and INT by 200%, and LUK by 20%.

Note: Deals 100% weapon damage to Non-Undead targets.

Heal yourself with spirit power. If you have more than 4 stacks of Spirit Power, increases the healing amount up to 4 times at 64 stacks.

Deals damage based on your weapon damage. Each of your skills gets an additional benefit from hourglasses you equip in your consumables slot. Hourglasses can be obtained from the Hourglass Pet available from the Book of Lore.

If Timepiece of Madness is active, applies the following effects:
Applies one stack of Mad for every use of Timeless Strike.
At 5 stacks of Mad, the next Timeless Strike consumes these stacks and applies Eternal.
Eternal boosts your critical strike chance by 80% and reduces the damage you deal by 30%.
Deals damage to your target and applies Temporal Rift to you. Temporal Rift stacks 4 times, lasts 30 seconds and is used by your other abilities.

Reverses time to heal you. Heal is increased by stacks of Temporal Rift and consumes those stacks.
Notes:
If Hourglass of Power is active, applies Power for 30 seconds, increasing damage, haste, crit chance, crit damage, hit chance, dodge chance and damage reduction by 10%.
If Infinite Corruption is active, applies Hourglass Heal for 20 seconds, a Heal over Time.

Applies Corruption Through Time. Corruption Through Time increases all damage you do by 20% for 10 seconds. Doesn’t stack.
Notes:
If Entropic Corruption is active, applies the following effects:
Entropic Harm for 10 seconds, increasing damage taken by 150%.
Entropic Mana for 7 seconds, increasing haste by 30% and reducing mana costs by 50%.
Entropic Power for 4 seconds, increasing damage by 100%.
Focus for 3 seconds, forcing affected monsters to attack you.

Foresee for 150 seconds.
Using Foresee Corruption again replaces this effect with Seer for 20 seconds.
Using Corruption Through Time again replaces Seer with Change the Future.
Change the Future applies Focus to enemies, and decreases damage taken by 80%, and increases dodge chance, haste, hit chance, damage, and crit damage by 100% for 5 seconds.

Welcome to Paradise, reducing damage taken by 40% and increasing haste by 30%. In addition, provides a Heal over Time that also regenerates mana.
Price of Paradise, reducing crit chance and crit damage by 40%.

Transient for 10 seconds, a self DoT that increases in strength.
Using Corruption Through Time again replaces Transient with Ephemeral for 5 seconds, increasing dodge and damage by +50%.

Applies Potential, increasing your Hit Chance by 20% for 20 seconds. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
If Timepiece of Inevitability is active, applies the following effects:
Applies Inevitable Corruption, increasing your outgoing damage and haste by 12% for 20 seconds.
Using the Timepiece of Inevitability while Inevitable Corruption is active applies Snap to your opponent, dealing significant damage to them after a short delay. Cooldown: 20 seconds.
If Timepiece of Pestilence is active, applies the following effects:
Applies Infectious Air, increasing the amount of damage the enemy takes by 20% for 10 seconds, stacking to 3 but is consumed by Temporal Collapse.
Your incoming damage is increased by 100% for 10 seconds.
Applies a light DoT to your opponent.
Applies Decay to your opponent, preventing them from healing.
Critical strike chance, Hit chance, and Haste increased by 7%

yami no ronin.d:
Attack your enemy from the shadows using the cover of darkness. Each hit applies Flash, increasing your Outgoing Damage, Hit Chance, and Crit Chance by 8% and Revealed, reducing your Dodge by 7%. Both effects last 15 seconds and stack to 10.
Note: battō (抜刀) means "Sword Drawing" in Japanese.

Sequentially cut through your opponent's defenses with three strikes, each dealing moderate damage. The first strike increases your Outgoing Damage by 20% for 10 seconds, the second strike increases your Outgoing Physical Damage by 20% for 8 seconds, and the third strike increases your Crit Damage by 150% for 6 seconds. Effects do not refresh. Always hits but can't crit.
Note: Tachi (太刀) means "Long Sword" in Japanese.

Wrap your weapon in shadows and lash out, releasing a shockwave of homing dark energy. The darkness gradually consumes your opponent before fading away, applying a DoT that grows progressively stronger for 10 seconds. Also applies Spinning Dragon, reducing your target's next attack to 0 damage. Always hits but can't crit.
Note: Yami no Māku (闇の幕) means "Veil of Darkness" in Japanese.

Gouge your target with your weapon, dealing strong damage. You also absorb their life force, restoring your health based on damage dealt. Also applies 1 stack of Flash and Revealed.
